title: Valar Atomics
description: Nuclear-industrial greyscale: a pale #f3f3f3 page with white bands and #e7e7e7 tiles, pure black bands and ink, and one machined gold for 1px button frames, active labels and hover fills. Near-square corners (4px, 8px on big cards), a very wide heavy caps face for the biggest lines, a tight neo-grotesk for headings and body, and an uppercase mono for every label.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the site's black bands use the `.dark` values as `dark` scopes, so dark mode is a black sibling of the same parts
Archivo Variable at wdth 125 / wght 900 stands in for Druk Wide, Hanken Grotesk for Saans, DM Mono for Saans Mono (all closed)
font-display is the wide face, meant for the two giant caps lines (hero, footer) and wordmarks; headings use font-sans
page gutter is 14px on phones and 5.9vw from 1024px; section padding is 16svh (clamped 5–10rem)
name: valaratomics-theme
